_about: Console numbers for the gate's guest-value probe (Sprint 6 Task 1c). Each entry names the peek chain the mission stage adds to PS2X_PEEK, the console value, a tolerance, and where the console value was measured. A missing read is NO-DATA, never a pass.

root_node_y.read: the pointer at actor+0x2e8 names the skeleton root node; word 1 of the node item (its Y translation at +0x04), float, the settled value (median of the last quarter of rows)
root_node_y.source: research/17 §1 table (spawn_pcsx2.rdram, the idle pose). On the fixed exe the settled value is pose-dependent: 5.031 (s6_probe, s6_gamepad2), 4.707 (s6_gamepad3) right after the bind-pose plateau, 5.504 at idle later in s6_probe; the defect was a decay to 0.0 (research/17 §4.1). The bar is therefore >= 4.0: not decayed, not the exact idle pose

move_scale.source: KNOWN §1 MoveScale row: 1.0 whenever the network has been heard from; single player has no idle path, so 1.0 throughout

teleport_steps.read: count of consecutive-row actor position steps faster than 120 u/s (words 7/8/9 of the actor block; the row period from the guest clock 0x4365c0 when present, else 1 s -- the mission stage samples at PS2X_PC_SAMPLER=1)
teleport_steps.source: research/25 §1.1: every step > 30 units per 4 Hz row (> 120 u/s) on ours was a teleport; a run reads ~40 u/s (s6_probe, 8 s forward hold)
